methodology.objectiveIds: Internal AdaptCloud traceability identifiers that paraphrase the current Architect Foundations task areas. They are not official exam task IDs.
methodology.legacyTreatment: The pre-existing compressed Architect bank remains intact. It is not retroactively assigned task-level provenance by inference. The dedicated audit layer guarantees explicit current-blueprint coverage.
methodology.auditLayer: Each current objective receives one original flashcard and two original scenario variants with per-choice rationales. No recalled, leaked, screenshot-derived, dump-derived, or copied live exam items are used.
methodology.mockAllocation: Per-domain mock counts are the repository's frozen 60-item practice geometry. The audit does not claim Anthropic publishes exact per-domain item counts beyond the domain weights.
